title: (D, δ): a two-feature signature for memory-access traces
description:
A low-cost, calibration-free signature for memory-access traces of a logical array: relative access density (D), information-equivalent to a normalized access count, and index-trajectory drift (δ), the net direction of the access trajectory over time. The pair flags O(n log n) → O(n2) degradation of the same code without per-class calibration.

The repository provides TypeScript and Python implementations that reproduce all results bit for bit, a deterministic corpus of seven sorting algorithms across five problem sizes and three input patterns, a pre-registered cross-domain validation on four non-sorting workloads, and a robustness analysis of the drift feature (order ablation, alternative estimators, sensitivity to analysis parameters, and the boundary of what two features can resolve).

Part of the author's master's research at PPGCO/UFU.
